items.title: Stored locations keep their accuracies
items.description: altitudeAccuracy, speedAccuracy and headingAccuracy are now saved with every fix and come back from getLocations(), the sync body builder and the default payload. A missing value is -1 (unknown), no longer 0, so filter with >= 0 first.

items.title: Sessions resume the way you started them
items.description: After a reboot, a relaunch or ready(), a parked SMART or SPEED session now comes back as the strategy the app started (continuous, periodic or geofences) on Android and iOS, and Android keeps its stationary periodic check.

items.title: Android: reopening the app recovers location
items.description: A foreground service that Android restarts in the background is denied location. Opening the app now replaces it with one that can track again.

items.title: iOS: no crash when setConfig() runs while moving
items.description: Reading the config on the motion thread while setConfig() wrote it could crash the app. Config access is now synchronised.
